backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for a cloud storage backend that composes access control, blob storage, and user approval mixins, and exposes endpoints for file management, sharing, notifications, trash, folders, user profiles, and admin operations.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping two implemented features—post-login approval status routing and the admin user-approval panel—to their relevant source files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON document containing one-sentence summaries of every frontend source file, describing each component's or hook's purpose and notable implementation details.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS stylesheet defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes, including colors for background, foreground, sidebar, charts, and UI primitives.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point for the React app titled 'CloudStorage' that mounts the app into a root div and loads the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React application component that sets up TanStack Router with all page routes, wraps the app in QueryClient and ThemeProvider, and handles authentication flow including profile setup, approval status checks, and routing to PendingApprovalPage or RejectedPage as needed.
frontend/src/components/ActivityFeed.tsx: Card component that fetches and displays recent file activities (upload, download, delete) with icons, file names, and relative timestamps in a scrollable list, showing a spinner or empty state as appropriate.
frontend/src/components/BulkDeleteDialog: Alert dialog component for confirming bulk file deletion that lets the user select a trash retention period (30, 60, or 90 days) before confirming, with a loading state during deletion.
A dialog component that allows sharing multiple selected files at once with a specified recipient principal ID and configurable view/edit/download permissions.
A full-screen error display component shown when the app fails to connect to the backend, offering retry and page refresh actions.
frontend/src/components/CreateFolderDial: A dialog component for creating a new folder (or subfolder) by entering a name, using the useCreateFolder mutation and showing toast notifications on success or failure.
frontend/src/components/DeleteConfirmati: An alert dialog that asks the user to confirm permanent deletion of one or more trash items, displaying item names and a loading state.
frontend/src/components/DeleteFileDialog: A dialog for moving a file to trash with a selectable retention period (default 30, 60, or 90 days) before the file is automatically deleted.
frontend/src/components/DeleteFolderConf: An alert dialog that warns the user about permanently deleting one or more folders (including all their contents) from the trash, listing folder names when five or fewer are selected.
frontend/src/components/DeleteFolderDial: A dialog that moves a folder to trash using the useDeleteFolderToTrash mutation, noting that files inside will be moved to root level.
frontend/src/components/DeleteFolderToTr: A dialog for moving a folder and all its contents to trash with a selectable retention period (30, 60, or 90 days) before automatic deletion.
frontend/src/components/ErrorBoundary.ts: React class component that catches runtime errors and displays a fallback UI with options to retry or reload the page, showing error details in development mode.
frontend/src/components/FileFilterDropdo: Dropdown UI component for filtering files by name, type, date range, and size range, displaying an active filter count badge and a clear-all option.
frontend/src/components/FileList.tsx: Main file and folder listing component that integrates search, filtering, sorting, pagination, selection, and per-item actions (preview, delete, rename, move, favorite, protect).
frontend/src/components/FilePreview.tsx: Full-screen file preview modal that renders images, videos, PDFs, and text files from raw byte data, with a download button and close control.
Debounced search input component with a clear button that notifies the parent of query changes after a 300ms delay.
frontend/src/components/FileSortDropdown: Dropdown component for selecting file sort field (name, date, size, type) and toggling sort order, with a clear-sort option.
frontend/src/components/FileToolbar.tsx: Composite toolbar component that combines the search input, filter dropdown, sort dropdown, and grid/list view toggle into a single responsive bar.
frontend/src/components/FileUpload.tsx: A drag-and-drop file upload component that supports multiple files, shows upload progress, and associates uploads with a folder. Uses identity-based authentication and updates a recent uploads context on success.
frontend/src/components/FolderActionPass: A dialog that prompts for a password before allowing a folder action, using SHA-256 hashing to verify against the stored hash. Enforces a 5-attempt lockout stored in sessionStorage.
frontend/src/components/FolderBreadcrumb: Renders a breadcrumb navigation trail for the current folder by recursively fetching parent folders. Includes a home button and clickable crumbs for navigation.
frontend/src/components/FolderPasswordPr: A dialog for entering a password to access a password-protected folder, with SHA-256 hashing and a 5-attempt lockout. Triggers a suspicious-access notification after too many failed attempts.
frontend/src/components/FolderProtection: A modal for managing folder password protection, allowing users to set, change, or remove a password and toggle a folder lock. Verifies the current password before making changes using SHA-256 hashing.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: The app's sticky top header with navigation, theme toggle, a notification bell with unread count badge, and a user avatar dropdown for profile and logout actions.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: The main app layout component that composes the Header, Sidebar, and an Outlet for page content, wrapped in an ErrorBoundary.
frontend/src/components/LoadingTimeout.t: A wrapper component that shows a timeout fallback UI with a refresh button if the loading state exceeds a configurable duration (default 45 seconds).
frontend/src/components/MoveFolderDialog: A dialog component for moving a folder to a new destination, filtering out the folder's own descendants from valid targets and showing a confirmation step before executing the move.
frontend/src/components/MoveToFolderDial: A dialog component that lets users select a destination folder via radio buttons and move one or more files there using the useMoveFilesToFolder mutation.
frontend/src/components/Notifications.ts: Displays a list of user notifications with type-specific icons and text, supporting mark-as-read and mark-all-read actions with loading and error states.
frontend/src/components/PaginationContro: A reusable pagination UI component that renders page navigation buttons, ellipsis for large page counts, and an items-per-page selector with range info.
frontend/src/components/PinnedFiles.tsx: Displays a horizontally scrollable list of the user's favorited/pinned files with file name and size, including loading skeleton and empty/error states.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: An onboarding form component that collects a display name and optional email to create a user profile, then calls the save profile mutation and notifies the parent on success.
frontend/src/components/QuickActions.tsx: Renders three quick-action buttons (Upload Files, New Folder, Create Text Document) that trigger file uploads, folder creation dialog, or blank text file creation, using identity checks and toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/RecentActivityCa: Displays a scrollable list of recent file activities (upload, download, share, delete) fetched via useGetRecentActivities, with loading skeletons, error, and empty states.
frontend/src/components/RenameFileDialog: Modal dialog for renaming a file that currently shows an informative error toast because the backend rename endpoint is not yet implemented.
frontend/src/components/RenameFolderDial: Modal dialog that allows users to rename an existing folder by calling the useRenameFolder mutation, with inline validation and toast feedback.
frontend/src/components/RestoreDialog.ts: Modal dialog that lets users restore selected trash items to either their original location or a custom path, displaying item details and a radio-group selection.
frontend/src/components/SharedByMe.tsx: Lists files shared by the current user with search filtering, per-item and bulk revoke actions, pagination, and loading/error/empty states.
frontend/src/components/SharedWithMe.tsx: Displays a paginated, searchable table of files shared with the current user, with checkboxes for multi-select and a button to copy selected file names to the clipboard.
frontend/src/components/Sidebar.tsx: Renders the app's collapsible left navigation sidebar with links to main routes (Files, Favorites, Recent, Shared, Trash, Settings, Admin) and conditionally shows an Admin Panel link for admin users.
frontend/src/components/SmartSuggestions: Shows up to 5 AI-driven file suggestions fetched via useGetSmartSuggestions, with loading skeletons, an error state, and an empty state.
Displays a storage usage card with a color-coded progress bar and used/total byte labels, fetched from useGetStorageQuota.
frontend/src/components/StorageQuotaIndi: Compact sidebar widget showing a small storage usage progress bar and used/total byte text, intended for display inside the sidebar.
frontend/src/components/TrashFilters.tsx: Provides a search input and a popover filter panel (owner principal, min/max file size) for filtering trash items, with an active-filter badge count.
frontend/src/components/TrashStorageIndi: Card component that shows how much storage the trash is consuming in bytes and as a percentage of the user's total quota.
frontend/src/components/UserStorageManag: React component that displays a list of all users' storage usage with progress bars and allows admins to edit individual user storage quotas inline.
frontend/src/contexts/RecentUploadsConte: React context provider that tracks recently uploaded files in memory, exposing add and clear operations via a custom hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using TanStack Query, initializing it with the current Internet Identity and an optional admin token, then invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFileFilters.ts: Custom hook that manages file filter state (name, type, date range, size range) and provides a memoized function to apply those filters to a list of FileMetadata objects.
frontend/src/hooks/useFileSearch.ts: Custom hook that maintains a search query string and provides a memoized function to filter FileMetadata by file name or extension.
frontend/src/hooks/useFileSorting.ts: Custom hook that manages sort field and order state and provides a memoized function to sort FileMetadata arrays by name, date, size, or type.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Custom hook and context provider that wraps the DFINITY AuthClient to manage Internet Identity login, logout, and identity persistence across page reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/usePagination.ts: Generic custom hook that manages pagination state (current page, items per page) and provides a function to slice any data array to the current page.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Central module of TanStack Query hooks that defines all data-fetching queries and mutations for the backend, covering admin checks, approvals, files, folders, sharing, notifications, trash, and storage management.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Exports a `cn` utility function that merges Tailwind class names using clsx and tailwind-merge.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that wraps the App component with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider before mounting to the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard page that checks caller admin status and renders summary stat cards alongside UserStorageManager and ActivityFeed components.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin panel page for managing user approvals, featuring a searchable table of users with approve/reject actions and confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main file browser page with folder navigation breadcrumbs, upload toggle, new folder dialog, and a FileList component.
frontend/src/pages/Favorites.tsx: Favorites page that displays starred files in a grid with options to preview or remove them from favorites.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home dashboard page showing storage overview, quick action links, pinned files, recent activity, notifications, and smart suggestions.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Renders the login landing page for CloudStorage, displaying feature highlights and a button to authenticate via Internet Identity.
frontend/src/pages/PendingApprovalPage.t: Displays a waiting screen for users whose accounts are pending admin approval, with options to refresh status, request approval, or log out; redirects to a rejected view if the user's approval was denied.
frontend/src/pages/Recent.tsx: Shows recently uploaded files in card or list view with support for selection, preview, deletion, search, sorting, filtering, and pagination.
frontend/src/pages/RejectedPage.tsx: Displays an 'Account Access Denied' screen for users whose approval request was rejected, with a sign-out button.
frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx: Provides a settings page where users can view their profile, configure trash retention period, and toggle the app's appearance theme.
frontend/src/pages/Shared.tsx: Renders a tabbed page showing files shared with the current user and files the user has shared with others.
frontend/src/pages/Trash.tsx: Displays trashed files and folders in a tabbed table with support for search, pagination, bulk selection, restore, and permanent deletion.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with dark mode, custom OKLCH-based color tokens, border radius variables, accordion keyframe animations, and typography/container-queries/animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state document describing a CloudStorage access-control system with Internet Identity auth, role-based approval flows, and an admin dashboard, tracking existing features, pending feature requests, and known incremental build issues.
